## How it was checked

- [ ] `make check` passes (format, vet, staticcheck, race tests, coverage, vulnerabilities)
- [ ] Behavior changes have tests, and a bug fix has a test that failed before the fix
- [ ] `docs/openapi.json` updated if a route changed (a test fails if it drifts)
- [ ] README or a decision record updated if behavior or a design decision changed
- [ ] No secrets or real customer data in the diff
